items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: Jim Robinson was one of those guys in Chris Kelly's band.

ctx.x: Isaiah had a struggle with... Oh yeah? He's up in Biloxi. He comes in to see Sam's wife at all. Oh yeah. They all keep in touch. Who was in Chris Kelly? That's kind of hard for me to remember. I forgot a lot of those guys. You mentioned the drum roll player.

Yeah, what's his name? Jim Robinson. Jim Robinson was one of those guys in Chris Kelly's band. This is another one. Everybody calls him by his nickname. Who did you go to Pensacola with when you first left?
We went to Pensacola with Buddy, Petit, Chani, we had Ray Chani on drums, we had Al Morgan on bass,
